method.interpretation: Search Console first isolates losses caused by temporary irrelevant private-driver queries. Google Suggest validates exact Italian problem wording. gscContext.rootCause: The costo-orario-autista-camion page lost 46 impressions while its average position improved from 2.5 to 1.5. Lost queries were unrelated private-driver and chauffeur-rental terms. This one corrected mismatch exceeds the net site loss of 33 impressions.
gscContext.deviceEvidence: Desktop impressions increased from 21 to 31; mobile fell from 47 to 5, matching the same irrelevant-query correction rather than a confirmed mobile technical fault.
limitations: Search Console does not expose a private ranking-cause label.
Indexing is controlled by Google and cannot be guaranteed by sitemap or request submission.
Directional Suggest data proves wording appears in suggestions, not volume or commercial value.
